name: Cone Overlap Test for Refractive Boundaries
definition: A pruning test to determine if a position bounding box (3D box) and a normal bounding cone can possibly satisfy the refraction conditions (view vector V on negative side of shading normal, within critical angle cone arcsin(1/η)).
summary: The Cone Overlap Test prunes light transport paths by checking if a position bounding box and normal cone satisfy refraction conditions, differing from similar tests by using 3D boxes instead of 2D triangles.
